t: simCAS: an embedding-based method for simulating single-cell chromatin accessibility sequencing data - PMC
s: To fill this gap, we propose simCAS, an embedding-based simulation framework that simulates scCAS data from low-dimensional embeddings with the user-defined settings. Our simulation framework can provide simulated scCAS data with unbiased ground-truth labels, such as cell states, data batches, and cis-regulatory interactions.
